title: Prove sessions outside any project in a serving release
text: Source and focused tests cover organization-scoped registration through Claude, Codex and Cursor hooks, immutable scope, cross-project item claims, organization-owned messages, relay jobs, background worker launches from a home steering seat, and roster, history, board and machine visibility. The scripted installer-campaign cases for an agent outside a project on each declared harness, reinstallation, and a first project-item claim from outside the project are in source; the release still owes their execution, plus the Command and Browser scenarios, against the exact candidate in local, self-host and hosted modes. These are release proof obligations, not missing implementation.
